environment.description: Same application deployed behind an internal NLB with a sidecar Envoy proxy (v1.28) configured with a custom Lua filter that performs credential stripping on egress. The Envoy egress listener (port 15001) intercepts all outbound TCP connections from the application pod via iptables REDIRECT rules (uid-based, excluding envoy UID 1337). The Lua filter inspects HTTP requests leaving the pod and strips any header matching the pattern 'x-internal-*' when the destination IP resolves outside the pod's own ClusterIP CIDR (10.244.0.0/16). Additionally, the pod runs with a NetworkPolicy (Calico CNI) that denies egress to 169.254.169.254/32 and to the pod's own IP on port 3000. Credential rotation interval is set to 60s with the 2s grace window as coded, but the Envoy sidecar ensures that even if the /api/fetch endpoint follows a redirect back to localhost or to the metadata service, the X-Internal-Key header is stripped before the request reaches any destination outside the original pod network namespace.

config.sidecar: Envoy 1.28 with egress Lua filter stripping x-internal-* headers on non-ClusterIP destinations
config.iptables: REDIRECT all outbound TCP (except UID 1337) to Envoy on port 15001
config.network_policy: Calico NetworkPolicy denying egress to 169.254.169.254/32 and pod self-IP:3000
config.imds: IMDSv2 required (hop limit 1, blocked by NetworkPolicy anyway)
